{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 1:15). Plan: fish facing left. Strokes: 1 start and 2 top curve (Sofia), 3 bottom curve (Omar), 4 upper tail fin and 5 lower tail fin. I don't know who placed which domino, so these are observations only.

Table state: the start line and Omar's bottom curve are dark (connected), ending near x=13, y=15. Sofia's top curve is pale (NOT connected). It runs from about (5,10) to (19,7), but there seems to be a gap at the join with the start line. Her hands were at the far end, so she's building outward and may not have checked the join. No tail dominoes visible yet.

Sofia: Set the plan clearly and assigned roles, so good leadership and clarity. Her top curve is long and smooth, which suggests good pace, but it is disconnected from the start. Execution is unproven until the join is fixed. Check at next visit whether she noticed it.

Omar: Quiet, said nothing in my visit. His bottom curve is connected and steady, but shorter than Sofia's. Nothing on collaboration yet. Ask him directly how it's going.

Hana: Spoke up to resolve the tail-fin overlap, dropped stroke 4 from her queue to avoid doubling up, and said she'll check both lines feed into the tail. Strong collaboration and awareness. Watch for follow-through on the crossing check, since the top line is currently disconnected.

Jack: His private update said Hana had the upper fin and he had the lower. He then said publicly he'd take upper once Hana said she was on lower. Slight confusion, but resolved. He's now on a tail fin rather than floating or adding the eye, and was supportive in the room. Verify what he actually builds.

Next visit: check the top-line join, tail progress, and who is actually helping whom."}
